front: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the locked character design reference. Produce ONE standalone full-body orthographic modeling reference image of this EXACT black humanoid robot, not a sheet or collage. Requested output resolution 2160 x 3840 pixels, portrait 4K, highest detail. Preserve exact proportions, helmet with featureless glossy black angular faceplate and circular ear discs, rounded shoulder plates, segmented chest and waist, pelvis, thigh shells, round knee joints, shin armor, mechanical five-finger hands and feet. Matte graphite-black armor with restrained satin highlights, dark joint surfaces. No redesign, new seams, accessories, weapons or glowing lights. Same neutral relaxed A pose as source: straight upright, head level, arms slightly spread about 15 degrees from torso, elbows straight, hands relaxed, legs slightly apart, feet parallel facing forwards. Same scale and framing across all four outputs: full figure centered, head at 6% image height, soles at 94%, no cropping. Strict orthographic projection, camera at middle body height, no foreshortening, no perspective or three-quarter rotation. Uniform light gray background and broad neutral studio illumination, readable dark surfaces, sharp contours, no dramatic shadow, no depth of field. No text, labels, dimensions, logo or watermark. Preserve left/right symmetry from reference. VIEW FOR THIS IMAGE: FRONT, camera directly facing chest and face, bilateral symmetric frontal silhouette. Show exactly one front view.
